name: Kalakar Kritadnyata Nidhi: Marriage Component
benefit:
##### ***Financial Assistance***

- Financial assistance of ₹20,000/- shall be sanctioned for the first wholly dependent daughter's marriage.
- Financial assistance of ₹15,000/- shall be sanctioned for the second wholly dependent daughter's marriage.
- Maximum two wholly dependent unmarried daughters shall be eligible for this benefit.

##### ***Disbursement***

- The financial assistance
_eligibility_text: ##### ***For the Artist*** - The applicant must be a Goan aged needy artist, born and brought up in the state of Goa. - The applicant must be recognized by the Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Goa. - The applicant must be not less than 50 years of age. - The applicant's annual family income from all the sources should not exceed ₹2,00,000/- per annum. ##### ***For Dependent Daughter(s)*** - The daughters must be wholly dependent on the eligible Goan artist. - The daughters must be unmarried at the time of application. - Maximum two wholly dependent unmarried daughters shall be eligible. ##### ***Relaxation*** - The Government may relax the age criteria for the artist for deserving cases under special circumstances.
